source: NC Emergency Management Phase 3 QL1 lidar, flown 2024-02-03 (NC Spatial Data Download, sdd.nc.gov, tiles ordered by hand 2026-11-16), for every building inside the downloaded tiles; buildings outside them keep the 2015 measurement (NC Floodplain Mapping Program Phase III QL2, NOAA Digital Coast id 6209, flown 2015-02-03). Each building says which in "survey".

coverage_2024.note: the whole model except a 24 m strip on its west edge between about 36.076 and 36.083 N (tile 10786406 was not ordered)

crs_note: heights in metres above median ground (classes 2, 11 road, 20) within a 10 m ring (25 or 50 m if sparse)

method.h: 90th percentile of building-class (6) returns in the footprint; falls back to unclassified (1) returns more than 2 m up when class 6 is under 30% of them
method.hmax: highest building/unclassified return with no 3 m gap in the 5 returns below it (drops birds, wires, noise)
method.h_2015: the 2015 measurement of the same footprint, for comparison

notes.no_building_in_2024: under half the footprint has anything more than 2 m up in Feb 2024: demolished, not yet built, or the outline is in the wrong place
notes.likely_newer_than_survey: (2015 records only) footprint empty or flat in Feb 2015
